chunks: And by his chain of narration, he said: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:

The Hour will not be established until a Riser for the Truth rises from us, and that is when God, the Mighty and Majestic, grants him permission. Whoever follows him will be saved, and whoever lags behind him will be destroyed. O servants of God! Go to him even if it is on snow, for he is the Representative of God, the Mighty and Majestic, and my representative.
ai.seo_question: Who is the Riser for the Truth and what is the consequence of following him?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* underscores the eschatological necessity of the Mahdi's emergence, framing obedience to him as the definitive criterion for salvation and destruction. It highlights his dual authority as both the Caliph of God and the Caliph of the Prophet, a concept central to Shia political theology regarding the Imam's divine mandate. The emphasis on following him 'even in snow' illustrates the absolute nature of this allegiance, regardless of external hardships.
